name: aki_staging
description: AKI staging by KDIGO 2023 creatinine criteria

tiers.label: Stage 1
tiers.range: Creatinine rise ≥ 0.3 mg/dL in 48h OR 1.5–1.9× baseline
actions: Fluid challenge 250ml NS over 1 hour (if not fluid-overloaded)

tiers.label: Stage 2
actions: Renal dose adjustment for ALL medications

escalation: Stage 3 requires immediate senior + nephrology review
